## Problem

What problem are you trying to solve? Describe the situation or limitation you've run into, not just the solution — this helps others suggest alternatives you may not have considered.

## Proposed solution

A clear description of what you'd like to see happen.

## Alternatives considered

Any alternative solutions or workarounds you've considered.

## Scope

Which part of the project does this touch?

- [ ] Backend / ingestion (`backend/`)
- [ ] Retrieval (`backend/retrieve.py`)
- [ ] Chainlit chat UI (`chainlit_app/`)
- [ ] Modal inference services (`modal/`)
- [ ] Portal / frontend (`portal/`)
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Other

## Additional context

Mockups, references, related issues, or anything else useful.
